title: Album Cover with Parental Advisory
coreRelationships: The subject's face and upper body are centrally framed, occupying the majority of the lower half of the image.
The subject's gaze directs attention towards the upper right quadrant of the image.
The gold chain provides a strong visual contrast and focal point against the dark clothing and skin.
The 'Parental Advisory' label is a distinct graphic element positioned in the upper right, contrasting with the photographic content.
reuseFormula: Recreate a dimly lit, medium close-up portrait of a person with dark, textured hair and a beard, wearing a dark shirt and a prominent gold chain. The person should be looking slightly upwards and to the right. The background is a plain, warm brown. Overlay a standard 'Parental Advisory Explicit Content' label in the top right corner.
